lines.en: I decide to spend the morning hanging out with Ami.
lines.zh: 我决定早上陪 Ami 待着。

lines.en: She tells me a little about some Korean drama show she’s been watching while the two of us make breakfast together."
lines.zh: 我俩一起做早饭，她跟我讲了几句最近在看的某部韩剧。"

lines.en: It feels strange being involved in a relationship like this out of virtually nowhere, but I'm getting used to it.
lines.zh: 几乎毫无预兆地就卷进这样一段关系，感觉挺奇怪的，不过我也在慢慢习惯。

lines.en: She seems rather comfortable with me as well...
lines.zh: 她好像对我也挺自在的……
